      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.finite_stables_of_open_wide_loci {k R : Type u} [Field k] [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {X : Type u_4} {σ : Type u_5} [Finite σ] (c : X → σ → k) (M : X → FGModuleCat R) (θ : Weight (FGModuleCat R)) (d : GrothendieckGroup (FGModuleCat R)) (hc : ∀ (x : X), GrothendieckGroup.of (M x) = d) (rep : ∀ (B : FGModuleCat R), θ.IsStable B → GrothendieckGroup.of B = d → ∃ (x : X), Nonempty (M x ≅ B)) (ho : ∀ (W : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty (FGModuleCat R)), IsWideClass W → IsOpen {x : X | W (M x)}) :
      (stableClassesOfClass θ d).Finite

      At a fixed class, openness of all wide loci implies finiteness of the stable isomorphism classes at each weight. Only filtrations by stable modules are needed.
